title: Approvals ledger - three approvals per build (Fable, external auditor, Kumar). A build may be called DONE only when all three are true.
rule: A flag may be true ONLY when <flag>_evidence is a regular file (no symlink, canonical path) in docs/approvals_evidence/ (the only accepted folder; never a README, code, CLAUDE.md or this ledger) containing the line 'APPROVAL <flag> APPROVES <build path>' for that flag and build, at least 20 words of prose and no 'not approved' / 'rejected' / FAIL line, and <flag>_evidence_sha256 holds its sha256. Commit the evidence FIRST, flip ONE flag, run `python3 tools/requirements_guard.py --accept-state` (it takes one newly-true flag per call, needs the evidence in git HEAD) and commit. The guard rejects anything else, a duplicate or removed row, edited evidence, a shortened chain, and any claimed_status DONE/COMPLETE/COMPLETED/GREEN/PROVEN/APPROVED without all three accepted. LIMIT: a local guard cannot stop a person with write access who writes the evidence themselves, one flag per commit; the real gate is Kumar plus the external auditor.
